candidate: One stable tests-first partition for short queries containing the word test/tests (the existing <=20-term explicit-test-intent rule). Production queries retain baseline demotion. No query rewriting, score changes, candidate-generation changes or file-diversity changes. No tuning after observations.
scope: Eight new explicit test questions plus four new production controls, four pinned exposed repositories/languages. Non-exhaustive implementer source judgments; files and related behaviors may have previous exposure. One fixed candidate, no sweep. The earlier two Kotlin helper questions are consumed motivation, not validation.

queries.query: Find tests for clearing a cookie while ignoring maxAge and supplied expiration

evidence.relevance: Asserts expiry clearing ignores maxAge and supplied expires.

queries.query: Find tests checking subdomain arrays with custom hostname offsets

evidence.relevance: Checks arrays under configured subdomain offsets.

queries.query: Check whether an application feature setting is enabled using its truthiness

evidence.relevance: Converts the setting value to a Boolean.

queries.query: Find tests for CRLF line anchors in multiline and only-matching searches

evidence.relevance: Checks CRLF and multiline end anchors alongside only-matching cases.

queries.query: Find tests restricting external preprocessing to paths matching a glob

evidence.relevance: Applies --pre-glob and checks matching and non-matching input files.

queries.query: Drain process stderr asynchronously while reading stdout to avoid a pipe deadlock

evidence.relevance: Selects asynchronous stderr consumption for the command reader.

queries.query: Find tests for zero-capacity priority queues handing values between producer and consumer

evidence.quote: real("demonstrate offer and take with zero capacity")
evidence.relevance: Exercises a zero-capacity priority queue with concurrent offers and takes.

queries.query: Find tests for deque offers and takes at the front and back

evidence.relevance: Checks forward and reverse offer/take operations through common assertions.

queries.query: Release a countdown latch and wake blocked fibers when its count reaches zero

evidence.relevance: Completes the signal when the last release changes the latch to Done.

queries.query: Find tests rejecting empty header names and trimming header whitespace

evidence.relevance: Checks empty-name rejection and whitespace trimming.

queries.query: Find tests percent-encoding form names and values containing spaces and plus signs

evidence.relevance: Checks encoding and decoding form name/value pairs.

evidence.relevance: Exposes nonblocking trailer lookup with null until available.
